package.name: omni_catch
package.description: omni-robot (design.md 30): the catch path and the play-catch behavior, robot code with no sim in it. The cores behind omni_cpp's catch_perception, catch_behavior and mode_manager (the ROS nodes, C++): the color-blob detector, the drag-aware ballistic filter, predict / intercept / tilt / catch / aim / return, the mode mux. The cores (perception.py, game.py, modes.py ...) have no ROS in them; the sim's harness runs them directly.
